description: This file defines the cfield_mgr class, responsible for managing custom fields within the TestLink testing framework. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving custom field definitions, as well as handling their values at different stages (design, execution, test planning). The class interacts heavily with database tables and manages various configurations related to custom fields, including their types, display locations, and applicability to different node types in the project hierarchy.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for handling custom fields, including CRUD operations, value management, and configuration for different contexts in TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cfield_mgr instance with database connection, loads configuration, and prepares helper objects.
